description: This file defines an interface class IEventHandler with virtual methods for handling container events such as start, stop, failure, and state change, using JSON data structures.

classes.name: IEventHandler
classes.description: An interface for handling container lifecycle events, to be implemented by classes that respond to container state changes.

methods.name: onContainerStarted
methods.description: Handles the event when a container has started, receiving relevant data as a JSON object.

methods.name: onContainerStopped
methods.description: Handles the event when a container has stopped, receiving relevant data as a JSON object.

methods.name: onContainerFailed
methods.description: Handles the event when a container has failed, receiving relevant data as a JSON object.

methods.name: onContainerStateChange
methods.description: Handles changes in container state, receiving relevant data as a JSON object.
